summary: Zone-control juggernaut whose tentacles slam the ground around her. Her whole lane depends on landing E: if it hits, she pulls your spirit out and you lose the trade. Dodge E and she's slow, with no escape.
threats: E (Test of Spirit) pulls your spirit out; hitting the spirit damages you, and tentacles spawn if you walk away.
Tentacles (passive) slam where she aims; standing near them in a fight is deadly.
Q (Tentacle Smash) is a slow skillshot; her tentacles also make it hit harder.
R (Leap of Faith) at 5 spawns tentacles for every enemy champion hit. Fight her away from them.

matchups.why: Vayne out-ranges Illaoi and Tumbles out of her E, so she rarely lands the pull that makes her lane work. W (Silver Bolts) true damage chips her down, and she has no gap closer.
trading: Auto her whenever she walks up; she can't reach you without E.
Tumble (Q) sideways out of her E skillshot.
Never fight near her tentacles; kite her away from them.
Condemn her into a wall if she charges in.
matchups.early: Kite and farm. She's slow and can't trade back without landing E.
matchups.spike: At 5 her R spawns tentacles; don't fight inside it. Walk away and wait it out.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and take plates while she can't contest.
matchups.jungle: She has no escape. Gank when her E is down.
matchups.build: Lethal Tempo. Crit and on-hit; armor boots.
matchups.remember: Dodge E, kite away from tentacles.

matchups.why: Kennen is ranged and fast enough to dodge Illaoi's E with Lightning Rush. He pokes her from range, and she has no way to reach him without landing E.
trading: Auto + Q (Thundering Shuriken) poke when she walks up.
E (Lightning Rush) sideways out of her E skillshot.
Stun her with the third mark if she charges in after you.
Never fight near her tentacles; kite her away from them first.
matchups.early: Poke freely and dodge E. She can't trade back without landing it.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R plus stun stops her R all-in; don't fight inside her tentacles.
matchups.wave: Hold the wave on your side so she has to walk through your poke.
matchups.jungle: She has no escape. Gank when her E is down.

matchups.why: Darius out-damages Illaoi in short fights if he dodges E and pulls her away from her tentacles. If she lands E, she wins the trade. The lane comes down to whether her E hits.
trading: Sidestep her E; walk behind minions so it hits them instead.
E (Apprehend) pull her away from her tentacles.
Stack Hemorrhage quickly once you're out of tentacle range.
If she lands E, walk back to your spirit instead of trading.
matchups.early: Even. Trade when her E is down and she's away from tentacles.
matchups.spike: At 5 her R spawns tentacles; don't fight inside it. Your R executes once it's over.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and trade when her E is on cooldown.
matchups.jungle: She has no escape. Gank when her E is down.
matchups.build: Conqueror. Armor boots against her tentacle damage.
matchups.remember: Dodge E, pull her off her tentacles.

matchups.why: Illaoi's tentacles and healing out-sustain Malphite's poke, and his armor does little against her repeated tentacle slams. He can't kill her alone, and she wins any extended fight near her tentacles.
trading: Q (Seismic Shard) her when she walks up, then walk away.
Stand behind minions so her E hits them instead of you.
Never fight near her tentacles; they out-damage your armor.
If she lands E, walk back to your spirit instead of trading.
matchups.early: Farm safely and Q poke. Don't stand near her tentacles to trade.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R plus your jungler can kill her, as long as you don't fight inside her R.
matchups.wave: Let her push and farm under tower; tentacles can't reach you there.
matchups.jungle: Ask for ganks; she has no escape once her E is down.
